title: Senior IT Infrastructure Administrator
description: Senior IT Infrastructure Administrator Digicel Kingston and St. Andrew Not disclosed Permanent full-time Updated 28/10/2026 Alridge Abigail Log in or register to apply Share Share this job Facebook Twitter Report This Job Save Save The Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer (SITE) is responsible for the operation, security and lifecycle management of Digicel’s on premises and hybrid (Microsoft Azure / Microsoft 365) server infrastructure in support of the global business. Company description: Digicel Group Limited Job description: Senior IT Infrastructure Administrator Primary Objectives of the Job: The Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer (SITE) is responsible for the operation, security and lifecycle management of Digicel’s on premises and hybrid (Microsoft Azure / Microsoft 365) server infrastructure in support of the global business. This includes all Group Head Office IT requirements as well as technical support to the technology teams across Digicel’s operating markets. The SITE works as a member of a team of engineers delivering first-class technology services on the Microsoft platform, including current Windows Server releases, Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID hybrid identity, and Microsoft 365. The role includes on-site physical support for technology solutions deployed across Digicel’s Tier III data centres, including SAN storage, backup and other high-availability infrastructure. A significant portion of the infrastructure estate runs on Linux and Unix. Strong experience supporting enterprise Linux distributions (e.g., Red Hat Enterprise Linux and RHEL-compatible distributions) and Unix platforms is key to success in this role. Duties and Responsibilities: Microsoft Infrastructure Services – evaluate and manage all on-premises Microsoft infrastructure services, including Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS), DNS, DHCP, Network Policy Server (NPS), Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS), SMTP mail relay and Remote Desktop Services (RDS) Identity and Access Management – manage hybrid identity across Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, including directory synchronisation, conditional access and multi-factor authentication in coordination with Group Security; execute joiner/mover/leaver access changes and privileged-access controls in line with Group IT access-control procedures Wi-Fi Services – manage all corporate Wi-Fi services (Cisco Meraki) and related network equipment to ensure consistent, reliable connectivity for users Virtualization – manage virtual server environments, including Microsoft Hyper-V and VMware vSphere, covering host lifecycle, capacity and licensing Microsoft 365 Administration – administer Microsoft 365 through the Microsoft 365 admin center and related admin portals; own the processes for subscription and license allocation across the markets and monitor license utilization; evaluate and coordinate upgrades, environment changes and maintenance work with Global IT Administrators Endpoint and Server Management – manage patch, software and configuration deployment using Microsoft Configuration Manager and/or Microsoft Intune Backup and Recovery – ensure server and data backups are configured, monitored and restore-tested; support disaster recovery testing for critical systems Monitoring and Reporting – evaluate, implement and manage infrastructure monitoring and reporting solutions to ensure all critical systems are under appropriate management, including remote management and SNMP integration with the Global Network Operations Centre (GNOC) Certificate Management (SSL/TLS) – manage the full lifecycle of certificates installations to prevent expiry-related outages Incident and Problem Management – provide troubleshooting expertise to resolve issues without vendor escalation where possible; raise and drive Microsoft and other vendor support cases to resolution; coordinate internal stakeholders and suppliers to restore service efficiently; complete root cause analysis (RCA) for major incidents Systems
